# TextInput

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTextInput> CreateTextInput( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);   // All take the identifier first and float geometry, as the constructor does.
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTextInput> CreatePasswordInput( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTextInput> CreateRevealablePasswordInput( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTextInput> CreateEmailInput( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTextInput> CreatePhoneInput( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTextInput> CreateNumberInput( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasTextInput(const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasTextInput(const std::string& id, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasTextInput(const std::string& id);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onTextChanged` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onTextChanged` | _Text changed_ |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void(size_t, size_t)> onSelectionChanged` | _Selection changed_ |
| `onValidationChanged` | `std::function<void(const ValidationResult&)> onValidationChanged` | _Validation changed_ |
| `onEnterPressed` | `std::function<bool(const std::string&)> onEnterPressed` | _Enter pressed_ |
| `onEscapePressed` | `std::function<bool()> onEscapePressed` | _Escape pressed_ |
| `onFocusGained` | `std::function<void()> onFocusGained` | _Focus gained_ |
| `onFocusLost` | `std::function<void()> onFocusLost` | _Focus lost_ |
| `onCleared` | `std::function<void()> onCleared` | _Cleared_ |
| `onPasswordVisibilityChanged` | `std::function<void(bool)> onPasswordVisibilityChanged` | Fired whenever the password mask is toggled (by the eye button or code). |

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
